Revision record
Revision 0.9 | 2026-11-12 | Thirteen authored sheets; KM4 contact status input added.
A1/001–A1/005: editable project records added.
A1/006: verified star-delta wiring retained and assigned sheet number A1/006.
Connectivity baseline: 15 components, 242 wire segments, 26 pin nets.
Q1/F1 overload settings and K1 delay remain unset.
No contactor, timer, motor, overload or protective behavior is simulated.
A1/011: K2:14 feeds the 24 V DC coil of source-backed contactor KM4 through A1/011; switched contacts remain unsimulated.
Design assumptions and limitations
This reference drawing set is incomplete: only A1/001–A1/017 are authored.
A1/006 is a static wiring model with source-backed component identities.
The schematic does not simulate contactor switching or timer sequencing.
Motor behavior, overload trip behavior and breaker interruption are not simulated.
Protection coordination, conductor sizing and installation suitability are not established.
Current and delay settings remain unset; engineers must not infer selected values.
Use only as an educational/reference design pending qualified review.
Not certified; not construction-ready.

description: Seventeen authored sheets: editable records A1/001–A1/005; Siemens/SEW star-delta starter A1/006; IFM sensor / Siemens PLC input A1/007; SITOP supply A1/008; 24 V distribution A1/009; PLC relay interface A1/010; Schneider contactor coil and auxiliary feedback wiring A1/011; Schneider NO/NC operator inputs A1/012; PLC I/O assignment schedules A1/013–A1/016; and a consolidated PLC I/O allocation summary A1/017. DI a.7 / I0.7 has no assigned device or function in this model. PLC logic, relay/contactor actuation, feedback interpretation, switching, diagnostic behavior and safety functions are not simulated. A1/018–A1/100 are not authored.
